body:
Migrated from docs/agent-memory/tests.md (entry dated 2026-09-22).

Under `go test -p 1 -timeout 30m -count=1 ./...` at 82a113a the package fails with `testing.go:1617: TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: unlinkat .../001/.git: directory not empty` — the assertions pass, but `t.TempDir`'s deferred `RemoveAll` cannot remove the unreadable subtree the test creates. Run alone (`go test -count=1 ./cmd/corvint -run '^TestAffectedUnreadableSubtreeFailsClosed$'`) it passes at both 82a113a and `main`, so this is cleanup ordering, not product behaviour. Done looks like: the test restores the subtree's mode in its own `t.Cleanup` (registered before the `TempDir` one) so the whole-tree run is green.
title: cmd/corvint: `TestAffectedUnreadableSubtreeFailsClosed` fails only inside the whole-tree run
